name: Amber Velasquez
source: The easygoing, energetic, and awesomest tomboy around. Her average week consists of fishing, playing baseball, attending church, enjoying family, and doing classes; then, studying three times over all her assignments! Without even noticing, she manages to live life to her fullest, with a never-ending and bright smile.
